scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/types && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
